spoken_summary: A Democratic congressman, Jared Moskowitz, sarcastically proposes an amendment to rename a bill concerning attacks on dogs. He suggests calling it the "Kristi Noem K-9 Relief Act of 2025," stating that the bill's essence is that "we really don't want anybody to kill dogs." This is a pointed reference to a controversy involving South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem admitting to killing her dog.
